g.text: Bridge v1b: every wire, at right angles, on the packages as they sit

Notch left, pin 1 bottom left, numbered as the package is. One track and one colour per net, named at its left end; a dot is a junction, a crossing is nothing. Every wire is read out of the schematic.

svg.text: rails joined end to end, as on the board
19 nets on tracks, 7 of them crossing the row; 26 supply pins on the rails. drawn by tools/wiring-diagram.py
